description_en: Submits resource evaluation results from Function Compute to Cloud Config by calling the PutEvaluations operation
description_zh: 函数计算通过PutEvaluations接口将资源评估结果返回给配置审计
name: PutEvaluations

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the delete mode. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false (default): Not enabled.

This parameter takes effect only when you manually trigger or periodically trigger a custom function rule to evaluate resources. If the delete mode is enabled, evaluation results that are not updated during the current evaluation are automatically deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用删除模式。取值：

true：启用。
false（默认值）：不启用。

仅当您手动触发或周期触发自定义函数规则评估资源时，该参数有效。如果启用删除模式，会自动删除本次评估期间未更新的评估结果
parameters.name: delete_mode

parameters.help_en:
The callback token. First activate Function Compute and create a function, then call CreateConfigRule (SourceOwner=CUSTOM_FC) to create a custom rule that points to the function. After the rule evaluation is triggered, extract the resultToken from the event parameter of the function, and call PutEvaluations within the current function execution window to submit the evaluation results.

The value of `ResultToken` is obtained from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127405.html. For more information about how to obtain the function event parameter from Function Compute, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73349.html
parameters.help_zh:
回调令牌。先开通函数计算并创建函数，再通过 CreateConfigRule（SourceOwner=CUSTOM_FC）创建指向该函数的自定义规则；触发规则评估后，从函数 event 入参中提取 resultToken，并在本次函数执行窗口内调用 PutEvaluations 提交评估结果。

`ResultToken`从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127405.html中获取。关于如何从函数计算中获取函数入参，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73349.html
parameters.name: result_token

Result.description_en:
The submit status of the custom function rule evaluation results. Valid values:

true: Succeeded.

false: Failed
Result.description_zh:
自定义函数规则评估结果的提交状态。取值：

true：成功。

fasle：失败
